one_liner: Tanger was redesigning its entire platform, and the work reached deep into the system architecture. I contributed by building front-end components, fixing bugs, and helping wire the middleware that translated third-party deal data into predictable formats for the UI.
projectSummary: Tanger was redesigning its entire platform, and the work reached deep into the system architecture. I contributed by building front-end components, fixing bugs, and helping wire the middleware that translated third-party deal data into predictable formats for the UI.

problem.summary: My role focused on the front end, but the front end depended on systems that were still evolving. Components needed predictable data and consistent patterns, and the site relied on a third-party service for deals and coupon information. That data had to be shaped by a middleware layer before it could reach the UI.

goals: Build front-end components that worked with evolving architecture
Wire middleware to translate third-party deal data into predictable formats
Fix bugs and ensure UI stability as the system evolved
Collaborate with backend engineers to shape data flowing into components
responsibilities: Built and refined front-end components while architecture was in flux
Implemented UI elements, fixed bugs, and tested edge cases
Collaborated with backend engineers to connect middleware to third-party deals service
Mapped incoming data, resolved mismatches, and verified component rendering
Worked closely with design team to ensure interactions matched intended experience
outcomes: The redesigned platform moved Tanger from static pages to a scalable architecture built around structured content and reusable components
Stabilized the integration between the middleware and the UI
Contributed to a system that is easier to maintain and evolve
Gained early experience at the intersection of system logic and interface behavior
Shaped how I think about system design and the relationship between interface quality and data clarity
